instruction: Choose the appropriate tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD for this task. On this machine, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to complete a linear eigenvalue buckling analysis. Physical problem: A pin-ended straight column is subjected to axial compression. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - Model the column as a line body with a beam cross-section. - The column axis is along the global Y direction. - The bottom end is located at Y = 0 mm. - The top end is located at Y = 1000 mm. - The rectangular beam section is: - Width = 10 mm - Height = 10 mm Model parameters: - Line body length: 1000 mm - Section type: rectangular beam section - Section size: 10 mm x 10 mm - Material: Structural Steel with the following linear elastic properties: - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3 - Use a consistent N-mm unit system. Boundary conditions: - Bottom end at Y = 0 mm: - Constrain UX = 0, UY = 0, UZ = 0, and ROTY = 0. ROTY is constrained only to remove axial rigid-body spin. - Leave the bending rotations ROTX and ROTZ free. - Top end at Y = 1000 mm: - Constrain UX = 0 and UZ = 0. - Leave UY and all rotations free. - Apply an axial compressive reference load of 1 N at the top end in the negative global Y direction. Analysis type: - Linear eigenvalue buckling analysis. - Extract the first buckling mode. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
